title: Correct total height
description: Essential: The response must correctly calculate the total fall height as 45 m.

title: Correct last-second height
description: Essential: The response must correctly calculate the height fallen in the last second as 25 m.

title: Applies kinematic equations
description: Important: The solution correctly uses the free-fall kinematic equations (e.g., v = gt, h = ½gt²).

title: Finds time of fall
description: Important: The solution calculates the total time of fall (3 s) from the given final velocity.

title: Calculates intermediate displacement
description: Important: The solution finds the height fallen in the first 2 seconds (20 m) as a step to find the last-second height.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: All calculated quantities include correct units (m, s, m/s).

title: Sign or formula error
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly uses a kinematic formula (e.g., using v² = u² + 2gh without accounting for direction) leading to a wrong height.

title: Last-second method error
description: Pitfall: Attempts to find the last-second height by incorrectly subtracting displacements (e.g., using h = ½g(t² - (t-1)²) with an algebraic mistake).
